title: Missing Exit handling
detail: The original code handled `Exit` exceptions to return the exit code or call `sys.exit`. The new code removes this block, so `Exit` will propagate uncaught, breaking callers that rely on it.

title: Incorrect default exit code
detail: When a command runs successfully without raising an exception, `exit_code` remains 1, so `sys.exit(1)` is called. The intended behavior is to exit with code 0.

title: Broken‑pipe suppression removed
detail: The original code wrapped stdout and stderr in `_PacifyFlushWrapper` when `errno.EPIPE` occurred to suppress broken‑pipe errors. The new code only checks for non‑EPIPE and re‑raises, so a broken pipe will raise an exception instead of exiting gracefully.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: The Twisted lock object does not expose a `locked` attribute; it provides a `locked()` method. Using the non‑existent attribute will raise an AttributeError at runtime, breaking the feed export.

title: Lock acquisition not awaited
detail: When the lock is free, the code calls `self._export_lock.acquire()` without awaiting the returned Deferred. This means the lock may not actually be acquired before the next operation, leading to race conditions and potential data corruption.
